TARAJAN KAKOTI GAON,
 P.O., P.S. AND DIST. JORHAT, ASSAM, PIN- 785001.
VERSUS  THE STATE OF ASSAM  REPRESENTED BY THE PUBLIC PROSECUTOR, ASSAM Advocate for the Petitioner : MR H R A CHOUDHURY Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM BEFORE HON'BLE
Heard Mr. H R A Choudhury, learned Senior counsel assisted by Mr. R A Choudhury, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. M P Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam for the State.

This application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner, namely, Rajib Ch.
Bordoloi, seeking bail in connection with CID P.S. Case No. 7/2023 registered under Sections 120B/420/467/468/471 IPC corresponding to G.R. No. 3005/2023, wherein he was arrested on 27.05.2023 and since then he is in custody.
Perused the case diary placed before the Court today by Mr. M P Goswami, learned Additional Page No.# 2/2 Public Prosecutor, Assam.

As per the FIR of the case, during detail departmental enquiry regarding the allegations of fraudulent issuance of driving licence with the connivance of brokers by the petitioner, Enforcement Inspector and In-charge District Transport Officer, Charaideo (under suspension) committed several irregularities and it was found that the petitioner misusing his official power as In-charge Rajib Ch. Bordoloi vs The State Of Assam on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197614970/
1 DTO conducted driving licence test by himself, hinting towards the fraudulent replacement of some fake driving licences of the States, misrepresentation of facts, like using false driving licence number during backlog Data Entry and also forcibly kept the sim card of the Junior Assistant of the office and used his user ID and password for using fake driving licence.

entities.text: Rajib Ch. Bordoloi vs The State Of Assam
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
During the departmental enquiry,
it was found that the petitioner had issued more than 6882 fake driving licences to the aid of brokers in different States including the neighbouring States.
Case diary reveals that those brokers who aided the petitioner with regard to issuance of fake driving licence are yet to be apprehended.
The case diary also reveals that while the petitioner was serving and posted in the office of the District Transport Officer at Dhemaji, he was arrested for the similar offence and was in custody.

Considering the materials available in the case diary against the petitioner with regard to his involvement in the alleged crime, the Court is of the view that it is not a fit case to grant bail to the petitioner, namely, Rajib Ch. Bordoloi, in said CID P.S. Case No. 7/2023.

Accordingly, this bail application of the petitioner, Rajib Ch. Bordoloi, in said CID P.S. Case No.
7/2023 stands rejected.
Return the case diary herewith.
